text:
emma_sales: Quick sync — ACME wants an EU-only POC (no egress outside EU) and a full subprocessor list + BYO-KMS option. Need pricing delta for pinning tenant to eu-west-1 and an SOW draft by EOD. Pls @ajay_se @maria_sec

ajay_se: Got it. Two quick clarifiers: 1) Do they require hard pin (no failover out of EU) or soft affinity with EU-first routing + failover to other regions only on capacity loss? 2) BYO-KMS = customer-managed keys in their KMS (we support AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure)?

paul_cto: Hard pin — legal says no copy or egress outside EU under any failure scenario. BYO-KMS must be AWS KMS in eu-west-1 (we're on AWS already). Happy to share DPA snippet.

maria_sec: Understood — hard pin + BYOK (AWS KMS) is higher bar. We'll need an attestation template and subprocessor inventory. Current public subprocessors: https://redwood.ai/subprocessors — but for EU-only we can exclude US cloud services if we run Dedicated EU-only capacity.

liam_prod: Technical note: we can provision a Dedicated EU cluster (eu-west-1) and configure tenant pinning with no cross-region failover. That means no automatic fallback to other regions; we keep active/passive inside EU only. There is infra cost for capacity reservation + isolation.

ajay_se: Example of the pinning config we propose for SOW (pseudo):

```
route_policy: "tenant_pin"
tenant_id: "acme-123"
regions_allowed: ["eu-west-1"]
failover: "disabled"
kms: {
  use_byo_kms: true,
  kms_provider: "aws",
  kms_region: "eu-west-1"
}
```

ajay_se: Also FYI: with hard pin we need to run acceptance tests for chaos/failover and log proof that no egress left region — add ~3 business days of infra/qa work to the SOW.

maria_sec: For subprocessors: we can provide the full list and a redacted attestation. If customer requires contractual subprocessor removal (i.e., no US SaaS for metrics), we need to move to Dedicated EU-only and remove monitoring SaaS from the data path. That adds a compliance workstream (legal + eng) — estimate 1-2 weeks for remediation and contract language.

emma_sales: Pricing ask: what's the delta vs standard hosted? Ballpark numbers ok — customer needs a rate card to sign the MSA.

liam_prod: Ballpark: Hosted multi-region baseline = X. Dedicated EU-only (pinned, reserved capacity, BYO-KMS) typically +25–40% depending on commit level and whether we replace any third-party telemetry services. If they accept 12mo commit we can push toward +20%. Also monthly minimum for reserved pool applies.

ajay_se: For SOW line items: 1) Dedicated cluster provisioning (infra) 2) BYO-KMS onboarding & key access test 3) Subprocessor attestation + contract amendment 4) QA/acceptance tests (no-egress proof) 5) Runbook & handoff. I'll draft effort estimates.

emma_sales: Great. Maria — can you confirm if BYO-KMS with AWS KMS (eu-west-1) needs HSM attestation or is standard KMS OK for Acme's legal?

maria_sec: I asked legal; for fintech they often ask for HSM-backed keys (AWS KMS qualifies with AWS CloudHSM backing). We'll confirm, but plan for HSM-compatible keys by default. Also will run the customer's security questionnaire — please attach it to this thread.

paul_cto: Attaching SQ now (see link). Timeline: we want POC start in 3 weeks. Is that feasible?

emma_sales: Thanks Paul — attaching to SOW draft. Ajay — can you surface a week-by-week plan that fits a 3-week start? Ops needs to know lead time for dedicated cluster (capacity and networking).

ajay_se: Week-by-week (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW + subproc attestation template + price delta
- Week 1: Dedicated cluster provisioning + network peering and KMS key exchange
- Week 2: Onboard tenant + run acceptance tests (no-egress proofs) + security questionnaire responses
- Week 3: Customer validation & cutover to pinned tenant

ajay_se: Risks: capacity lead time if we need GPUs for heavy evals; OSS model quantization work may add time.

ops_bot: infra-ticket created: INF-4821 — Dedicated EU cluster provisioning request. ETA: 7 business days for initial cluster.

emma_sales: OK noted. If infra ETA is 7bd then 3-week POC start is tight but possible if infra team prioritizes and they accept reduced capacity initially. I'll update Paul.

maria_sec: Action items for me: 1) Confirm HSM requirement 2) Produce subprocessor attestation 3) Review SQ answers. Target EOD for docs.

ajay_se: Action items for me: Draft SOW + pricing delta + sample route_policy config. ETA EOD.

emma_sales: I'll draft the email to ACME with the line items and ask for commitment on 12mo vs month-to-month to lock pricing. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
